{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print the result
print("Mean age (excluding -1):", mean_age)

# Also print the number of valid ages for transparency
print("Number of valid ages:", len(valid_ages))"}
